description: The file defines a ViewModel class for a calculator app using SwiftUI. It manages calculation logic, handles user input, supports multiple operations, and interacts with an external calculator core if available. Contains UI state management and conditional imports for core calculation functionalities.

classes.name: CalculatorViewModel
classes.description: SwiftUI ObservableObject managing calculator UI state and logic.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets calculator inputs, result, and error messages to default states.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs the selected operation on input values, handling errors and formatting results.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a Double value into a localized string with specific decimal formatting.
